gwt.given: an output parameter collection that already contains a parameter named '@ExistingId', and an ignoreParameters exclusion set
gwt.then: CreateOutputParameters<TModel> excludes both the parameter names in ignoreParameters and any parameter names already present in the incoming collection (such as '@ExistingId', matched case-insensitively) when appending output parameters for TModel, and returns the parameter collection
gwt.when: CreateOutputParameters<TModel> is called on that collection, passing that ignoreParameters set

sources.label: CreateOutputParameters merges pre-existing parameter names into ignoreParameters
